title: Hinomori Shiho — Waiting For Our Turn〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Jam Fest
Rookie Stage

rows.Speaker: Vocalist
rows.Line: Alright, you guys, here's our next song!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (This stage is bigger than I was expecting.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The crowd doesn't look very big, but there probably are a lot of people here based on the capacity of this venue...)

rows.Speaker: Vocalist
rows.Line: C'mon! I know you guys can do better than that!

rows.Speaker: Vocalist
rows.Line:
Thanks, everyone!
Enjoy the festival, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Good performance...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They probably debuted around the same time as us, but they didn't let the size of this stage affect them.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The next band's on in... Let's see... Thirty minutes? I guess I should go back to where the others are, but...)
...ho... Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Saki...?
Oh, you're all here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What are you spacing out for?
We kept calling your name, but you wouldn't notice.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry, I was thinking about something.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But are you all here to watch the other bands?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We actually came looking for you after you said that you wanted to watch them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We sent quite a few messages, but I guess you didn't notice them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...
Sorry, I was focused on the show.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We had a feeling.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Back in the green room just now, we were talking about going over to see the main stage!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And we wanted to see what you thought, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, about that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I also plan on checking out the main stage, but I'd like to keep watching here for a bit longer.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is a band you like going to be playing soon?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Not exactly.
I'm trying to imagine what it's gonna be like when we do this for real.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Imagine, huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The rookie stage is the smallest one at this festival, but for us, it'll be the biggest stage we've ever played on.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And the crowd attending this festival seems kinda different from the ones we've encountered until now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which is why I want to get a clear image of us performing up there. So that I don't lose my nerve.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This is our first time playing at a big festival, so I really don't want to make any mistakes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, feel free to go see whoever you like. I'm going to stay here for a bit longer, but I promise to keep an eye out for your messages.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In that case, I think we should all stay here and watch.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'd pictured it myself, but I still don't have a good feel for the audience.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me neither. I'd like to try what you're doing, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, we should do everything we can to make sure we put on a good performance!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, Shiho, give us a lecture regarding what we need to do♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, there's nothing for me to lecture about...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But you all are more than welcome to join me.
